name: halftone-dissolve
description: Scene A dissolves into scene B through a growing halftone dot field: accent ink dots pop onto a fixed grid smallest-first, each opens into a window onto B, until the windows merge and B fully replaces A.

vars.description: Grid pitch for the halftone field.
Threshold ordering: ltr sweeps left to right, center grows from the middle, noise scatters.
Seconds from mount start when the dissolve begins.
Ink dot color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.
Optional departure. Default none: scene B holds until the frame cuts.
